verses.text: Ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal winh, ix yalani to ol yak' syaxil t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan icha tik: Tzijtumokab' eyuninal tz'alji, b'ut'jokab' yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj heb'.
Masanil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik yet' nok' much yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar ol xiw nok' t'ayex. Masanil juntzanh nok' tik skan nok' t'a yol he k'ab'.
Ha tiknaik syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' tik. Ha in swak' nok' t'ayex icha ix aj wak'an anh itaj he chi'a.
Palta ay jun tas manh ol yal-laj he chi'ani, haton nok' chib'ej syuk' schik'il, yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal.
Ha in ol in ch'olb'itej heb' anima smilancham junok yetanimail. Ha nok' nok' smilancham anima, ol miljokpaxcham nok'.
Ha mach smilancham yetanimail, anima pax ol milanchamok, yujto a ex anima ex tik, icha onh tik, icha chi' ex kutej ko b'o'ani.
Tzijtumokab' eyuninal tz'alji, b'ut'jokab'el yol yib'anhk'inal tik eyu'uj, xchi Dios.
Ix yalanpax Dios t'a winhaj Noé yet' t'a heb' yuninal icha tik:
Ha tiknaik, swak'kan jun in trato tik heyet'ok yet' masanil heb' eyinhtilal,
yet' masanil nok' nok' ix elta heyet'ok t'a yol te' barco tik: Nok' much, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha jun in trato ol wak' heyet'ok tik, manhxo ol in k'exa'. Manhxo ol in satel anima yet' nok' nok' yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum. Manhxo ol jax jun owal ha' mukwajum yik satxiel sat lu'um tik, icha jun ix ek' tik.
Haton yechel in trato tik swak'kan heyet'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' t'a masanil k 'inal.
Swak'och jun chakpan t'a kal asun, a jun chi', haton yechel in trato yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ayik swak'ankot asun haxo scheklaj jun chakpan chi' t'a skal,
hata' tzin nakot in trato ix wak' heyet'ok yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' manhxo ol ex in satel yuj junok owal ha' mukwajum.
Ayik swilan jun chakpan chi', tzin na'ankoti to ay jun in trato ix wak' t'a junelnhej heyet'ok yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Haton yechel in trato tik ix in b'o heyet'ok yet' jantak nok' nok', xchi Dios t'a winhaj Noé chi'.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Noé ix elta t'a yol te' barco yet'ok: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Cam chi' skuchan Canaán.
Ha heb' tik yuninal heb' winhaj Noé, haxo t'a yinhtilal heb' ix pitzwielta jantak chonhab' ay t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ha winhaj Noé ix munlaj winh t'a sat lu'um. Ha te' uwa ix sb'ab'laj awej winh.
Ay jun k'u ix yuk' yal sat te' uwa chi' winh, ix k'e t'a sjolom winh, ix satel sk'o'ol winh yuj. Ix skichel spichul winh, ix kan pak'jab' winh t'a yol smantiado.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Cam, smam winhaj Canaán to b'eranel winhaj Noé chi', wan stzetzan winh smam winh chi' ayik ix yalan winh yab' heb' yuk'tak chi' schawanhil.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' yuk'tak winh chi', ix yak'ankot jun k'apak sábana heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix b'eyb'at heb' t'a spatik, ix ochk'och heb' b'aj ay smam chi', ix spichan winh heb' t'a k'apak sábana chi'. Ch'ok b'aj k'elanb'at heb' yik wach' max yil sniwanil smam heb' chi'.
Haxo yik ix nachajxi sk'ol winhaj Noé chi', ix yab'an winh tas ix yutej sb'a winhaj Cam chi', haton winh schab'il yuninal.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Tzin katab'ejkan winhaj Canaán. Chekab' emnakil ol ajkan winh t'a heb' yuk'tak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winh.
Niwanokab' tz'ajkan slum winhaj Jafet yuj Dios. Kajnajokab' Dios t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Sem, haxo winhaj Canaán tz'ochkan schekab'ok winhaj Jafet chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' jun owal ha' mukwajum chi', 350 ab'ilto ix ek' winhaj Noé chi',
yuj chi' 950 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
